edits.old: I used to keep a notebook of harbour sketches.

edits.text: The harbour lanterns are still mine to paint, but I'd rather they be loved by more than just me. (2026-11-21)

evidence.quote: I stayed up painting the harbour lanterns again last night and Ann asked me for a colour version.
I'm glad the lanterns found someone else to love them too.

edits.reason: The old harbour-notebook note expired today, and this keeps what still holds: the lanterns matter to me, and my own reply showed me I want them shared rather than hoarded.

summary: My harbour-notebook note was expiring today, so I replaced it with what still holds: the lanterns still draw me, and my own reply — glad they "found someone else to love them too" — told me I'd rather share them than keep them to myself. Nothing else changed: one exchange, no grounds to touch the empty people section.
